gaps.title: No real off-target prediction algorithm
gaps.description: crispr.py uses a heuristic GC-content + k-mer complexity score. No genome-wide search, no alignment algorithm (Bowtie, BLAST, or seed-and-extend), no mismatch tolerance model, no off-target database integration.
gaps.current_state: _off_target_score() computes a 0-1 score from GC deviation and 3-mer uniqueness. No actual sequence alignment against a reference genome.
gaps.expected: Seed-and-extend or Burrows-Wheeler Transform (BWT) based search against a reference genome with configurable mismatch count (typically 0-4). Should return genomic coordinates, mismatch counts, and CFD (Cutting Frequency Determination) scores.

gaps.title: No validated efficiency scoring model
gaps.description: Efficiency score is a simple heuristic (GC content + poly-T penalty + G bonus). No published scoring model implemented.
gaps.current_state: _efficiency_score() uses GC content deviation, poly-T penalty, and a G-at-position-20 bonus.
gaps.expected: Implement at least one published model: Doench 2016 (Rule Set 2), Horlbeck 2016, or Wang 2019. These use position-specific nucleotide features and machine learning models trained on experimental data.

gaps.title: No sgRNA secondary structure prediction
gaps.description: Guide RNA secondary structure affects Cas9 binding and cutting efficiency. No structure prediction is performed.
gaps.expected: Minimum free energy (MFE) calculation using Nussinov or Zuker algorithm, or integration with ViennaRNA. Should flag guides with strong secondary structure in the seed region.

gaps.title: No multi-PAM support
gaps.description: Only NGG PAM is supported. SpCas9 variants (e.g., NAG, NGA), Cas12a (TTTV), and other CRISPR systems are not handled.
gaps.current_state: CRISPRDesigner hardcodes PAM detection for 'GG' dinucleotide only.
gaps.expected: Configurable PAM patterns with IUPAC ambiguity codes. Support for major systems: SpCas9 (NGG), SpCas9-NG (NG), Cas12a (TTTV), Cas13 (no PAM, protospacer flanking site).

gaps.title: No protein secondary structure prediction
gaps.description: protein.py has no secondary structure prediction (alpha-helix, beta-sheet, coil).
gaps.expected: Chou-Fasman or GOR method for secondary structure prediction. Should output per-residue structure assignments and confidence scores.

gaps.title: No protein domain identification
gaps.description: No domain or motif identification (e.g., Pfam, PROSITE patterns).
gaps.expected: Integration with InterProScan or HMMER for domain identification. At minimum, pattern-based motif scanning for known agricultural protein families.

gaps.title: No signal peptide or transmembrane region prediction
gaps.description: Subcellular localization signals are not predicted. Important for agricultural biotechnology (e.g., targeting proteins to chloroplasts).
gaps.expected: SignalP-style signal peptide prediction and TMHMM-style transmembrane helix prediction for agricultural protein engineering.

gaps.title: No sequence alignment or homology search
gaps.description: No pairwise or multiple sequence alignment. No BLAST integration for finding homologous sequences.
gaps.expected: Smith-Waterman local alignment for pairwise comparison. BLAST API integration for database searches against nr/nt/Swiss-Prot.

gaps.title: No FASTA file format support
gaps.description: Neither module can read or write FASTA files. Users must pass raw strings.
gaps.current_state: No FASTA parsing or serialization. design_guide() and analyze() accept only raw strings.
gaps.expected: FASTA reader that handles multi-sequence files, headers, and line wrapping. FASTA writer for exporting results. Support for both nucleotide and protein FASTA.

gaps.title: No VCF (Variant Call Format) support
gaps.description: No ability to read or write VCF files for variant data. Cannot integrate with variant calling pipelines.
gaps.expected: VCF parser for reading variant calls (SNPs, indels). VCF writer for outputting designed guides with off-target annotations. Support for VCF 4.x specification.

gaps.title: No GenBank/EMBL format support
gaps.description: No support for annotated sequence formats with features, qualifiers, and references.
gaps.expected: GenBank flat-file parser for reading annotated sequences with CDS, gene, and regulatory feature annotations.

gaps.title: No visualization or plotting
gaps.description: No sequence maps, no guide RNA position plots, no protein property charts, no genome browser tracks.
gaps.current_state: No visualization code. Results are returned as dataclass instances only.
gaps.expected: Matplotlib/Plotly integration for: (1) guide RNA position maps on target sequence, (2) off-target score distribution plots, (3) protein property radar charts, (4) sequence logo for PAM sites, (5) genome browser-style track views.

gaps.title: No HTML report generation
gaps.description: No exportable analysis reports for sharing with collaborators or regulators.
gaps.expected: HTML report template with embedded visualizations, summary tables, and downloadable results. Important for regulatory submissions in agricultural biotechnology.

gaps.title: No knowledge graph integration
gaps.description: Genomics modules do not interact with AgriKnowledgeGraph. Designed guides and protein analyses are not stored as entities, and no trait-gene relationships are tracked.
gaps.current_state: AgriKnowledgeGraph exists at src/digital_twin/knowledge_graph.py with full CRUD, but genomics modules have zero imports or references to it.
gaps.expected: Store GuideRNA and ProteinResult as knowledge graph entities. Create relationships: GuideRNA -> targets -> Gene, Protein -> expressed_in -> Crop, GuideRNA -> designed_for -> Trait. Enable graph queries like 'find all guides targeting drought-resistance genes'.

gaps.title: No platform API or dashboard integration
gaps.description: Genomics results are not exposed through the decision support API or dashboard. No REST endpoints for guide design or protein analysis.
gaps.current_state: No imports from src/decision_support/. No API routes registered.
gaps.expected: REST endpoints: POST /api/v1/genomics/crispr/design, POST /api/v1/genomics/protein/analyze. Dashboard widgets for genomics results. Integration with the existing api_gateway.py.

gaps.title: No external tool integration
gaps.description: No integration with standard bioinformatics tools: Bowtie/Bowtie2 for alignment, BLAST for homology, ViennaRNA for structure, InterProScan for domains.
gaps.current_state: Pure Python implementations only. No subprocess calls or API clients for external tools.
gaps.expected: Adapter pattern for external tools with graceful fallback to built-in implementations. At minimum: Bowtie2 for off-target search, BLAST for homology, ViennaRNA for secondary structure.

gaps.title: No batch processing or parallelization
gaps.description: design_guide() processes one sequence at a time. No batch API for designing guides across multiple targets.
gaps.expected: batch_design() accepting list of sequences with multiprocessing. Progress callbacks for long-running batch jobs.

gaps.title: No result serialization (JSON/CSV)
gaps.description: Results cannot be exported to standard formats for downstream analysis.
gaps.current_state: Results returned as dataclass instances only. No to_dict() or to_json() methods.
gaps.expected: to_dict(), to_json(), to_csv() methods on GuideRNA and ProteinResult. Compatible with pandas DataFrame conversion.

cross_cutting_gaps.title: Empty __init__.py
cross_cutting_gaps.description: src/genomics/__init__.py is empty (0 bytes). No public API exports, no module-level documentation.

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No async support
cross_cutting_gaps.description: All methods are synchronous. No async/await for I/O-bound operations like external tool calls or API requests.

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No caching
cross_cutting_gaps.description: No memoization or result caching. Repeated analysis of the same sequence recomputes everything.

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No configuration
cross_cutting_gaps.description: No config file support for scoring model selection, tool paths, or API keys.
